incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A collapsed multi-story building with debris scattered around, showing significant structural damage, with other buildings and trees visible in the background.

observations.description: A multi-story building is heavily damaged, with its roof and upper floors collapsed and rubble piled on the ground.
A damaged building with blue window frames and visible balconies, surrounded by debris.
A tall, dark pole stands next to the damaged building.
A green tree is visible behind the debris pile.
A white sack is placed on a concrete block in the foreground.
